heading: Wednesday, January 17, 2024
topLine: DeepMind's AlphaGeometry solves 25 of 30 olympiad geometry problems.

items.headline: DeepMind's AlphaGeometry solves 25 of 30 olympiad geometry problems
items.summary: Google DeepMind published AlphaGeometry in Nature. It pairs a neural language model with a symbolic deduction engine and was trained on 100 million synthetic examples without human demonstrations. On a benchmark of 30 IMO geometry problems from 2000 to 2022 it solved 25 within the time limit; the previous best method solved 10, and the average human gold medallist solved 25.9. Solutions are checked by the symbolic engine, and the result is a benchmark evaluation, not a live competition.
